notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I got some news. I think, it isnt new to me any of this and therefore I will get to the point.

Second part of the game: Still working on it. I know, what a shocker, but nonetheless, there is an update to let you know what I have been up to lately.

So uhm, I have remade the game inside some RPG maker after one year because I wanted to expand upon how I interact with the world I build
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35188238/23b78569f74f09cbd0868dd037980e8579c36c38.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35188238/39d3b871d3f0b7b326b10249b35f32fc473be976.png[/img]

You will still get the normal and usual CG that you got used in the first game in major dialogue options:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35188238/7ad366d1ad158aff16efe1902e3fdd7794287d6b.png[/img]
But also a version of the RPG Maker world:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35188238/2b147a430c8aff5843ddc32cdffc070d26b238fc.png[/img]

I think this is time-consuming to draw the world from two points of view and overall draw it twice, but I think it is worth the end quality. I am currently still working on worldbuilding and drawing.. grass, it's really boring to me, but I will get it finished eventually and accordingly.

I hear you maybe asking "When will the game be finished?" and I don't know, but probably when it's gonna be done and that would be it. I am sorry to some extent for taking so long for finishing the game and yet not really sorry at all, but just some slight remorse that I know I could work more on the game than I am currently am.

[b]Note: Some images might be prone to change and updates and don't represent the final product.[/b]
